title: Distinguish value and terminal semantics
scope: Exact one-state policy value and terminal bootstrapping

items.prompt: One continuing state follows a fixed policy: reward 1 each step, deterministic self-transition, γ=0.5 forever. Compute V. This is NOT a terminal transition.
items.solution: V=1+0.5V, hence V=2. A truly terminal transition would have zero bootstrap instead.

items.prompt: One-step value target: reward=1, discount=0.9, estimated next value=10. The transition ends the task (terminal=true). Return the target r+γV_next only when bootstrapping is valid; a true terminal uses r. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: Use a zero continuation value for true termination. A mere recording time limit in this stated continuing model retains the bootstrap: target=1. This numerical target is not a policy-performance claim.
